name: The Queen of Flow
description: Seventeen years after being wrongly imprisoned, a talented songwriter seeks justice against the men who caused her downfall and killed her family.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Talented songwriter Yeimy plots revenge against those who put her in prison. She recalls her high school crush Charly, who's now a famous singer.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Teenage Yeimy mourns her loss. Soul and Bass raise money by putting on their first concert. To prove himself to his uncle, Charly accepts a risky job.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After Yeimy confronts Charly about what he's done, he takes advantage of her feelings for him, and comes up with a plan so his uncle won't kill her.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When Juancho refuses to believe Yeimy is guilty, Charly tries to convince him otherwise. In prison, Yeimy receives a threat, followed by shocking news.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After visiting Yeimy in the U.S., her grandmother returns home to a nasty surprise. Years later, Charly wonders about his adopted brother's parentage.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Juancho mourns Yeimy's supposed death as she arrives in Puerto Rico and begins training for her undercover work as music producer Tamy.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Her training complete, Yeimy returns to Medellín for the first time in 17 years and finally comes face to face with Charly. Erik enters a music battle.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Yeimy reunites with an unsuspecting Juancho. Vanesa gets approached by a talent scout for modeling. Charly tries to win over a critical reporter.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Yeimy attends the next "cockfight" to find new talent. Charly performs a concert with reggaeton star Sebastián Yatra and debuts Yeimy's new song.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The modeling agent pressures Vanesa to expand her personal boundaries. Yeimy brings a young new singer to Charly, and later tries to bug his office.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Vanesa tells her parents about her new job. Erik runs away from home after a fight with Charly. Juancho is forced to work for Excelsior Studios.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Erik looks for answers about his birth parents. Yeimy and Juancho collaborate to produce Cris's first track. Gema suspects Charly is still seeing Zulma.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Yeimy releases an incriminating video of Charly and Zulma, but in trying to ruin his career, she also ends up impacting his daughter, Vanesa.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Erik gets an anonymous offer that spurs him to secretly record an album with Yeimy and Juancho. Charly works on repairing his image and relationships.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: When the DEA goes after Manín, Charly gets caught in the crossfire. Yeimy tries to get Vanesa to open up to her, and gives Gema PR advice.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Erik finds out the name of his birth mother. Yeimy tries to get closer to Gema. Charly returns home and is determined to find the mole.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Charly tasks Axl with reviewing the security footage. Lucio follows Carrancho to a phone booth. Cata's growing suspicions about Yeimy annoy Juancho.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Erik meets the informant's go-between at the park. Ligia reaches her limit with Manín. Juancho and Yeimy fight over her relationship with Charly.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Erik learns who his informant was. Gema seeks another man's attentions. Charly pays a surprise visit to Yeimy's home. Vanesa and Silvana go to a party.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The accident has devastating repercussions. Yeimy spots an opportunity and calls Silvana's father. Jack declares to Yeimy his feelings for her.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Yeimy makes a comment that leads Juancho to doubt her identity. Vanesa becomes distraught when she hears Silvana's father speak to the press on TV.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Gema searches Vanesa's room to see if she's lying about using drugs only once. Juancho contacts the musicians shown in photos with Yeimy on her website.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Juancho confronts Yeimy with his suspicions about who she really is. Vanesa argues with her parents after they reveal their plans for her.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Juancho argues with Yeimy about her vengefulness. Charly grows suspicious of Yeimy and Juancho and has her followed. Vanesa's family goes to therapy.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Charly pays a visit to the modeling agency. Yeimy calls reporter Zulma and asks to meet in private. Drug dealer Ruko reconnects with Vanesa.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Erik's single debuts on the radio. Yeimy finds a way to get Charly to ask his uncle for a favor that could reveal Manín's location.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: When Erik's single surpasses Cris Vega's, Charly starts to ask about Pez Koi and ends up in a fight with Juancho. Gema visits Triana and gets a shock.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Falcioni realizes he's being followed. Unable to reach Yeimy, Charly sinks into despair. Erik celebrates his hit single with his friends and family.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Falcioni signs a deal with the DEA. At a press conference, Erik reveals he's Pez Koi. After telling Yeimy about her affair, Gema gets an anonymous text.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Charly flips out once he learns Pez Koi's real identity, but his mother intervenes. Cata follows her suspicions. Yeimy and Zulma plot their next move.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Manín orders his thugs to do whatever it takes to get Charly to bring him cash. Vanesa gets in trouble with the law. Cata continues her investigations.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Manín's men make a discovery about Yeimy. Gema and Charly are forced to take a painful step regarding Vanesa. Cata confronts Juancho with her findings.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Vanesa grudgingly starts rehab. As Yeimy takes her relationship with Charly to the next level, Juancho worries about her. Manín's men go after Ligia.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Juancho and Yeimy argue over how far she'll go to get info from Charly. A photo makes Manín suspicious of Charly. Vanesa sees a familiar face at rehab.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: When Erik calls Manín on the phone Yeimy gave him, the DEA traces the call to the criminal's exact location and launches an operation to capture him.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: In rehab, new friend Pau shows Vanesa a healthier way to escape her problems. Cata is shocked by a revelation on her wedding day.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Gema harbors doubts about her separation. Cata has a few too many drinks and gives an emotional speech. Yeimy decides to continue living undercover.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Yeimy feeds Zulma her next news story. Charly and Juancho get heated while negotiating the terms of an upcoming concert. Erik visits Vanesa in rehab.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Yeimy, Gema and Charly decide to change the venue of the concert. Erik and Irma's connection grows stronger. Vanesa runs away from rehab.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Yeimy feels conflicted after Vanesa asks for a favor. Cata confides in her mom about Juancho. Charly gets involved again with Manín's business.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Cris Vega gets a nasty surprise. Erik and Charly rehearse before their big concert. Yeimy helps Gema find a PI to investigate her husband's activities.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Yeimy persuades Vanesa to speak to her dad. On the day of the concert, Irma helps Erik with his nerves, and Charly arrives at the venue to a surprise.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Vanesa brings Ruko to visit her dad backstage before the show. Axl catches Juancho letting teens in through a back door. Erik invites a guest onstage.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: When the concert's final performance is sabotaged, Erik scrambles to recover. Vanesa overhears her parents talking about Ruko. Gema's PI follows Charly.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Cata decides to keep closer tabs on Juancho. The PI's photos rattle Yeimy. Vanesa finds Ruko's drugs. Zulma posts her interview with Cris Vega.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Yeimy overhears Charly and Gema's amicable divorce negotiations and leaps into action. A suitor visits Vanesa. Erik asks Irma to be his girlfriend.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Juancho asks Yeimy if she's still in love with Charly, and can no longer contain his own feelings. While out with friends, Vanesa runs into Ruko.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Irma signs with a label. The PI snaps photos of Charly conducting his shady side business. Cata's mom tells her how to fill the void in her marriage.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Cata secretly takes her mom's latest advice. Erik shares a detail about his birth mom that stuns Juancho. Charly blackmails Gema to get what he wants.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Juancho helps Yeimy process his news. Charly investigates the car following him. Gema goes on a date, and later tries to gather evidence against Charly.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Juancho tries to dissuade Erik from asking Charly about Yeimy Montoya. Yeimy requests a DNA test. Gema gets the ammunition she needs to fight Charly.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Vanesa has a difficult talk with Pite. Lucio captures the PI. Cata catches Juancho lying again. Yeimy makes a change in her relationship with Charly.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Charly gets bad news from Don Edgar. Yeimy helps Vanesa with Ruko. When Gema shows Charlie her evidence against him, he realizes he needs to stop her.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Charly asks Lucio for a favor. Yeimy baits Ruko with the help of the DEA. Cata pressures Juancho into signing more artists, including Cris Vega.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: After learning Gema will be working late at the studio, Charly calls Lucio. When Vanesa changes Gema's mind about Charly, Yeimy plays her last card.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Yeimy asks Zulma to record her testimony on video. Pite offers Vanesa advice based on his own experience. Juancho follows Charly to see who he meets.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Erik questions Charly's version of events. Gema's new boyfriend crashes a church service. Yeimy asks Juancho to pick up the DNA test results.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Axl looks through Excelsior's security footage. Zulma posts the video of Yeimy telling her side of the story. Cris Vega auditions for Juancho.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: As Juancho's marital doubts increase, Cata spends more time with Cris. The police get forensic test results back. Erik and Yeimy collaborate on a song.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: In light of the DNA evidence, Charly scrambles to cover his tracks. Pite tries to cheer up Vanesa. Juancho learns of Cata's efforts to get pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Erik follows Irma home and is shocked by what he discovers. Pite makes a confession to Vanesa. Over drinks, Cris gets Cata to confide in him.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: The police go after Yeimy, who has to decide whether to flee or turn herself in. Erik finds out how the police learned where Yeimy was hiding.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Juancho reveals Yeimy's true identity to the police. Cata shares surprising news with Juancho. Charly convinces the police to let him talk to Yeimy.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Axl shows Charly a new track he created. After hearing Juancho's news, Yeimy receives a surprise visitor. Charly coaches Irma to perform seductively.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Vanesa confronts Yeimy. The ballistic report comes back. Yeimy is warned she's going to be attacked that day. Zulma launches a campaign to free Yeimy.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Vanesa senses her father is hiding something from her and searches his bedroom. The police get a warrant to arrest Charly's shady accountant.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: After being visited by Jack and Juancho, Yeimy makes a big decision. Axl fumes over creative differences with Charly. Irma gets fed up with her dad.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Yeimy finally divulges her identity to Charly. Lucio gives his girlfriend an item for safekeeping. Vanesa introduces Pite to her father.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Yeimy tells Erik who his birth mom is and tries to answer all his questions. The police close in on Lucio. Ligia learns the truth about Erik's origins.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Erik reveals who his birth father is to Charly. Cata pays a surprise visit to Yeimy's home. The police call an anonymous number listed on Lucio's phone.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Yeimy agrees to work for Surround on one condition, and later reveals a new secret online. When Mora gets greedy, Charly's lawyer comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Misfortune puts Cata in the wrong place at the wrong time. Axl suspects Charly is stealing his song. Lucio's girlfriend discovers what's on the phone.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Juancho makes a decision about Cata. Lucio's girlfriend pays Charly a visit. Irma discovers who her father injured. Yeimy arranges to meet with Axl.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: The police help Yeimy get a visit with Mora. Charly meets Lucio's girlfriend to pay her off. Irma tells her father what she learned about his victim.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Axl auditions for Yeimy. Ligia visits Irma's father. Erik and Cris's social media contest begins. Irma tries to dispel rumors about her and Charly.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Rosalía ardently pursues Juancho. Mora asks to speak to Detective Contreras and Yeimy. The man who unlocked the phone for Marlene goes to the police.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Rosalía tries to create distance between Juancho and Yeimy. Irma's father, José, visits Ligia. Yeimy seeks Axl's help in proving Charly's guilt.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Yeimy arranges to meet Marlene's friend who unlocked the phone. A fan asks Erik a delicate question. Juancho decides to wait no longer to pursue Yeimy.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: José attends his job interview. After Vanesa hears the recording, Yeimy is forced to tell her harsh truths. Juancho learns Rosalía tried to buy votes.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Vanesa's loved ones urge her to give the police what she found in the closet. Yeimy has a tough talk with Jack. Cata makes an announcement to Juancho.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Charly confronts Axl, who has a change of mind. During his concert, Erik invites his dad to join him onstage. The recording analysis results come back.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: When Vanesa gets a call from her father, she makes a confession to him. Charly plays his last hand. Two years later, everyone's fates are revealed.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After celebrating Erik’s wildly successful world tour, Yeimy becomes convinced she is being followed and that an incarcerated Charly is to blame.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Yeimy, obsessively worried that Charly is going to be released early, asks Zulma for help. Charly mobilizes his fans to help declare he’s a changed man.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A father-son work trip to Spain turns into a nightmare after devastating news reaches Charly and Erick. Yeimy's work for Soul and Bass continues.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Yeimy's notebook falls into enemy hands, as an unidentified body ignites chaos. Yara sings for Patrono while Soraya schemes behind her back.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As gossip and accusations mount online, Charly sinks into despair. Yara fights for her place in the industry, and an accident triggers old demons.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Yeimy's disappearance, her family starts to fall apart, and enemies begin to close in. Deep in the jungle, a figure emerges.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Yeimy struggles to survive without an identity, Charly falls into a dangerous scheme that pits him against everyone. Prison becomes a battleground.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Yeimy fights to reclaim her identity, a sinister video game turns Charly's tragedy into a spectacle. Yara shines during an important audition.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Yeimy's voice echoes around her home, driving Charly crazy. Severo hides Yeimy's identity. Yara's talent reignites Soul and Bass, sparking Irma's envy.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Severo's boat is intercepted, while Rusvel plots to recover Yara. Charly and Alma face their grief, and Mike continues to pull strings.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As the truth begins to emerge, Charly tries to heal from the shadows that haunted him. Yeimy is startled into action, and Yara defies Marinilla's power.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Yeimy pieces together her memory. Irma fights for the musical throne as Yara debuts her first song. A lost camera triggers a manhunt.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Yara establishes herself as the new voice of Soul and Bass, and Irma seeks the source of the messages. The Kraken returns to the jungle.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Charly demands focus and discipline, as Yara conquers those at Soul and Bass. As she nears her goal, Genoveva prepares for an irreversible shakeup.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: A new reward shakes things up for Mike. As Yara deals with the burden of success, she's forced to confront her secret feelings for Charly.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: A brutal attack shakes Soul and Bass and unleashes a wave of suspicions and revelations. In the jungle, Yeimy's safety hangs in the balance.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: As Charly recovers, Yara's guilt forces her to make a drastic change. Mike's plan moves forward, and Severo's pathway is clear to be a millionaire.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Irma's new song climbs the charts, and Yara makes her return. As Charly regains creative control, tensions with Erick mount and disrupt Soul and Bass.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: A cruel twist forces Irma to face online hate. Yara must choose between the garage and music, while Soraya intensifies her fight for Charly.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: A song revives what was lost. A video kicks off a web of deception that sparks Charly's suspicions about Yara. Irma tries to recover from betrayal.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Charly confronts Fredy in prison, and they strike a deal. Yara is resolved to set boundaries, while a new Soul and Bass alliance threatens Mike's plans.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Charly is entangled in a web of suspicion as Alma disappears. Irma reinvents herself and Mike accelerates his plans before everything is lost.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: While Chacón falls into the Vallejo's trap, Yara says goodbye to Charly, throwing him off balance. Irma and Trejos' success irks Erick.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Irma and Trejos celebrate their success and Erick records with his crew. In prison, Mike suffers from a betrayal, and a dark plot shakes Soul and Bass.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Erick finds inspiration in Leo Fire as Yara shines in the studio. Fredy's betrayal ignites a plot of revenge that could change everything.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Mike celebrates his freedom by launching Parce Music. Irma and Trejos closeness stirs up social media. Yeimy tries to get back home.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Yara and Charly grow closer in Guatapé, while Yeimy tries to flee from her closely guarded confinement. Mike maneuvers to seize control in the industry.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Mike steps up his verbal attacks on Yeimy, while a message shakes Yara's trust in Charly. Irma is kidnapped, and a spot in Paris ignites tensions.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Axl enters prison as Mike continues his plans to destroy Soul and Bass. Charly searches for Irma amid threats that shake him and others.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Mike intensifies his campaign against Charly with lawsuits and scandals, as the fight for Paris heats up. Yeimy and Irma bond in their cell.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: While Yeimy and Irma advance their escape plan, Mike unleashes his fury. Soraya betrays Yara, and Erick relies on music to keep Irma's fans full of hope.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Yeimy and Irma seek refuge in the woods while Mike loses control. At the ranch, Genoveva and Jerónimo intercept the police but are unprepared.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Yeimy's return shakes everything up. As Irma reexamines her life, Erick struggles with the distance. Charly makes a vow to reclaim what's been lost.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Genoveva is shaken from her confrontation with Irma. Yara struggles with massive changes. Yeimy returns to Soul and Bass and puts Yara on the spot.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Charly's obsession with winning Yeimy back resurfaces old wounds. As Genoveva plots her revenge, Yeimy struggles to conceal her fragile health.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Yeimy's peace in Guatapé is broken by Charly and Yara. Mike unleashes a legal battle on Ángel, and Yeimy does everything to keep her secret under wraps.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: An anticipated concert turns into a battleground as Yeimy faces a challenging night, Yara strives to shine and Mike pulls strings to let chaos reign.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Following the blackout, Charly makes a moving message, reigniting the audience's energy. As Yeimy gathers her strength, an enemy is watching closely.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Yeimy and Charly are a triumph at the concert. Yara wavers between her feeling for Charly and a proposal from Meteoro. Yeimy keeps her health a secret.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Yeimy and Charly confront Genoveva over a longstanding grudge. Yara makes a decision that could change her career. Mike conspires to ruin Soul and Bass.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Soraya confesses a secret to Yara and fears being fired. Mike plots to sabotage an upcoming performance, and Yeimy suffers from a health scare.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: A painful revelation shakes Charly and Yeimy. With time of the essence, Mike changes course and targets the most vulnerable of the Soul and Bass family.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: As Yeimy's health deteriorates, she prepares herself and her family for a painful goodbye. Genoveva's desperate search for Jerónimo yields no results.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Charly's grief turns into revenge as he makes a terrible vow. Mike tries to rehabilitate his image, unaware that enemies loom in the background.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Mike points the finger at Charly for his attack. As tensions rise between Irma and Yara, everyone wonders: Who will be the new Queen of Flow?

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Genoveva's rage drives her to the edge as she goes after Mike. Yara's music career hangs in the balance as a media war with Irma unleashes chaos.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Yara makes a decision that leaves Charly devastated. Mike is terrorized as Genoveva plots her revenge. The rivalry between Yara and Irma intensifies.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Yara shines at an event, while Charly is accused of being Yeimy's executioner. Soraya spreads new gossip, and Genoveva prepares a drone for Botero.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Yara celebrates Alma's birthday but struggles seeing Charly. Botero is the victim of an attack. Mike confronts Charly with an old memory of Yeimy.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: A fashion show performance destroys Irma's confidence but leads to a truce. Mike's setup puts Charly and Alma at risk.
